dimensions.assessment: Affects communities, local governments, and communications providers operating within areas declared under a wildfire-related major disaster or emergency.
dimensions.evidence: carried out entirely within an area for which the President, the Governor of a State, or the Chief Executive of an Indian tribal government has declared a major disaster or an emergency related to a wildfire

dimensions.assessment: Removes federal environmental and historic preservation review requirements to accelerate the rebuilding of damaged communications facilities.
dimensions.evidence: replaces a communications facility damaged by such disaster or emergency or makes improvements to a communications facility

dimensions.assessment: Does not appropriate funds or alter federal spending, focusing strictly on regulatory exemptions.
Narrowly applies statutory exemptions from specific environmental policy and historic preservation statutes for defined recovery projects.
dimensions.evidence: A Federal authorization with respect to a covered project may not be considered a major Federal action under section 102(2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to projects carried out within five years of a qualifying wildfire disaster or emergency declaration.
dimensions.evidence: to be carried out not later than 5 years after the date on which the President, Governor, or Chief Executive made such declaration

missing_information: Data on how many communication facilities or projects typically qualify under these disaster declarations annually.
importance_detail.rationale: Exempts specific post-wildfire communications infrastructure rebuilding and hardening projects from federal NEPA and NHPA environmental and historical reviews.
